# Spectakles

> Stop rehearsing. Start speaking. Spectakles is the AI roundtable for Group Discussions. Practice real conversations, handle pressure, and get placement ready.

## Core Information
- Website: https://www.spectakles.in/
- Mission: Helping students find their voice in group discussions and campus placement rounds through intelligent AI simulation and standard 5-parameter rubric assessment.

## Key Pages
- [Home](https://www.spectakles.in/): AI group discussion simulation, rubric breakdown, and placement prep.
- [About](https://www.spectakles.in/about): Mission, philosophy, and team behind Spectakles.
- [FAQ](https://www.spectakles.in/faq): Common questions from students and institutions regarding the platform.
